purpose.zh: 慢速控制，练核心和肩部稳定
purpose.en: Build core and shoulder stability with slow control.

text.zh: 膝盖慢慢收向胸口，髋保持水平
text.en: Drive your knee slowly toward your chest and keep your hips level

text.zh: 高位平板，手在肩下，身体一条直线
text.en: Hold a high plank, hands under shoulders, body in one line.

text.zh: 收紧腹部停一下，再换另一侧
text.en: Brace your abs and pause, then switch sides.

cautions.zh: 先做2–3分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop right away if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
